attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited filed a transcript of the earnings call for Q2 and H1 FY27 results on November 19, 2026. The company reported record revenue of INR1,936 crores for Q2 and INR3,655 crores for H1 FY27. Order backlog reached approximately $1,044 million as of September 2026. Data center revenue contribution was 20% in Q2. EBITDA for Q2 was INR175 crores with a 9% margin. Profit after tax for Q2 was INR73 crores. The company aims for a 10% EBITDA margin in Q4 FY27.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited has released the audio recording of the earnings call for the Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027. The call was hosted on November 14, 2026. This filing serves as a further update to the company's previous letter dated November 9, 2026. The announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The audio recording is available for stakeholders. The company requests dissemination of this information to all relevant parties.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited submitted newspaper advertisement clippings to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange on November 14, 2026. The advertisements were published in Mint, Business Standard, The Free Press Journal, English edition, and Navshakti, Marathi edition. These publications contained the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The submission was made pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document includes clippings from the English and Marathi editions.

attchmntText: Monitoring agency report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited. The report concerns the preferential issue aggregating Rs. 386.36 crore. The company utilized Rs. 9.04 crore for working capital requirements during the quarter. Total utilization stands at Rs. 172.03 crore. Unutilized proceeds amount to Rs. 214.33 crore. These funds were transferred to Fixed Deposits. The issue size was revised from Rs. 410 crore to Rs. 386.36 crore due to undersubscription. Shareholder approval for revised objects was obtained via special resolution on March 19, 2025. No deviations from issue objects were observed.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited submitted an investor presentation for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027 to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India. The company reported revenue of 1,936 crore rupees for Q2 FY27, representing a 22% year-over-year increase. Profit after tax rose 31% to 73 crore rupees. Half-year revenue reached 3,655 crore rupees, up 23% year-over-year, with profit after tax at 129 crore rupees. The order backlog exceeded 1,044 million dollars. The company aims to achieve 23% to 27% revenue growth and 38% to 50% profit after tax growth for fiscal year 2027.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results Q2FY27".
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue of 1,936 crore for Q2 FY27, up 22% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at 175 crore, up 23% year-on-year. Profit after tax was 73 crore, up 31% year-on-year. The order backlog reached 1,044 million US dollars, an 88% increase year-on-year. New order bookings for the quarter were 298 million US dollars. For the half year, revenue was 3,655 crore and EBITDA was 335 crore. The company provided FY27 guidance projecting revenue growth of 23% to 27% and PAT growth of 38% to 50%. The filing was submitted to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered both Standalone and Consolidated results. MSKA & Associates LLP issued a Limited Review Report on the Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results. The auditors noted delays in remittance of import payments, repatriation of export proceeds, and other receipts aggregating to Rs. 20.44 crores, Rs. 7.44 crores, and Rs. 11.14 crores respectively, as at September 30, 2026. Management has filed applications for extension of time limits and condonation of delays, with responses awaited. The auditors' conclusion is not modified regarding this matter. The Standalone Unaudited Financial Results were also reviewed and approved by the Board.
